text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P3 optional realization, separate from PHRF-10 backend. Current Cascade34.scala implements validated kernel parameters, evaluation/integral and summaries; that does not supply exact seven-state transition/injection/observation operators and their derivative/covariance qualification. Keep scope bounded to the realization and independent dense expm/semigroup/off-grid shock oracles, using Gale for reusable algebra. Preserve one shared trial impulse across positive/undershoot branches and explicitly declared observation/drive assumptions; do not infer admissibility of boxes, observation averaging or arbitrary forcing from impulse-kernel parity. This remains a prerequisite only for the optional finite-state route, not for using Cascade34 as a kernel in CompactCondition/TrialBanded or for unified release. No implementation or new numerical qualification in this assessment.
